name: gang-cutter
theme: the street gangs of a near-future city at night, the figure shown alone on a plain light grey studio backdrop, no street, no rain, no signs, no scenery
description: A wiry young street gang member in a long dark olive hooded parka of worn nylon with the hood up, a scratched off-white plastic respirator mask over the face, dark denim jeans and dirty white trainers, a faded red bandana tied round the left upper arm, a machete with a black taped handle gripped in the right fist, held level and straight out in line with the outstretched arm
